title: Concept: Next.js development error overlay in a response
description: A Next.js development error overlay element in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The overlay prints the failed component, the compile error and often the server-side stack, and it is only rendered by a development build that was shipped to production.
applicability: Deployments that render a Next.js development error overlay element into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The overlay prints the failed component, the compile error and often the server-side stack, and it is only rendered by a development build that was shipped to production.
